boundedQuestion: Can a Producer bypass N312 by choosing a different observerIdentity string and fabricating matching raw evidence?

vulnerableReplay.defect: N312 treats any observerIdentity string different from producerIdentity as independent and authentic.

teacherDecision.source: in-toto Attestation Framework plus layout-authorized functionaries
teacherDecision.novelty: N312 names an observer; in-toto binds a typed statement to a subject, authenticates it with a signature, and checks the signing key against coordinator-authorized functionaries.

boundary: Fixture signatures prove only protocol behavior. Key custody, revocation, threshold policy, real observer independence, and evidence truth remain unverified.
